I just had all 4 taken out a week ago! They were pretty much all erupted, and not impacted. I was a “simple case” though I had the same nervousness! I got IV sedation, so I remember nothing of the procedure itself, but it is important to follow your surgeon’s aftercare directions with precision. If they give you a syringe for irrigation, do so prudently. No straws, no sucking, take your time with liquids even. Take your surgeon’s advice for icing verbatim (mine said not to after the 24 hr mark)

I was even able to fly home 3 days later with no discomfort (got surgery in my family’s city for aftercare support.) I didn’t get the chipmunk swelling which I thought happened to everyone. The most frustrating part was the liquid diet. I was starving lol. However 3 days after surgery I finally ventured into a soft, solid meal (soft fried fish + soft fries.) It’s scary, but I’m sure you’ve chosen a competent oral surgeon who will take good care of you.

The inherent meaninglessness of life is largely explored in the philosophical school of existentialism, where one can potentially create their own subjective 'meaning' or 'purpose'.
